$comment: Single source of truth for which repositories are documented and how they are read. Edit this file to add a repo, change the branch, or re-point a local checkout. Everything else is derived automatically.

repos.name: nlp-openapi-bff
repos.title: OpenAPI BFF
repos.summary: Public / partner facing HTTP entrypoint. Serves the Legacy API and OpenAPI Warranty surfaces used by MyAIS, USSD, partners and BBL, converts every request into Kafka commands on the loyalty bus, and consumes CDC topics to keep its read models warm.

repos.name: nlp-backoffice-bff
repos.title: Back Office BFF
repos.summary: Internal HTTP entrypoint for the Back Office web console. Everything a campaign / partner / point administrator does lands here first. Permission guarded per endpoint, owns the Back Office MongoDB, and issues Kafka commands to the loyalty domain.
repos.audience: Back office operators, campaign & partner admins

repos.name: esb-loyalty-management-agg-common
repos.title: Loyalty Aggregator (agg-common)
repos.summary: Kafka-only aggregation layer. It owns the coarse grained business entry topics (register a loyalty member, adjust a balance), enriches them with D03 reads, then fans the work out to the TMF658 domain service over Kafka request/reply and publishes the final success or failure event.

repos.name: nlp-cronjob
repos.title: NLP Cronjob
repos.summary: Scheduled Nest Commander jobs. Reconcile files, expire points, send SAP/SFTP, notify offers, and publish Kafka commands into the loyalty bus — there is no HTTP API.
repos.audience: Operators and batch schedules — CLI jobs, not channels

repos.name: esb-dos-TMF658-loyalty-management-nlp
repos.title: TMF658 Loyalty Domain Service
repos.summary: The system of record. A Kafka-only TMF658 domain service that owns the loyalty MongoDB (members, accounts, balances, transactions, programs, vouchers) and implements the real business rules: earn, burn, redeem, transfer, expire, tiering and reporting.

d03.title: D03 TMF APIs
d03.description: AIS shared TMF Open API estate (customer, party, product inventory, resource catalog, loyalty account/currency). Read mostly.

d64.title: D64 / LID analytics
d64.description: Analytics + reporting data store used for point transaction reports and large read models.

mongo.title: MongoDB
mongo.description: Per service document store. Back Office BFF owns its own DB, the TMF658 domain service owns the loyalty DB.

redis.title: Redis
redis.description: Cache and pub/sub fan-out for hot lookups and cross instance invalidation.

kafka.title: Kafka (Event Service Bus)
kafka.description: The backbone. Every cross service call in this platform is a Kafka message, usually request/reply with a correlation id.

sap.title: SAP
sap.description: Budget / WBS availability checks for campaign funding.

ikm.title: IKM
ikm.description: Content management for campaign and offer content.

mfaf.title: MFAF
mfaf.description: Notification / SMS fan-out platform reached over Kafka.

camara.title: CAMARA
camara.description: GSMA CAMARA OAuth / number verification APIs.

storage.title: Object storage
storage.description: MinIO / S3 compatible bucket for uploads, templates and exports.

openapi-master-data.title: Master data API
openapi-master-data.description: Shared master data (error event message templates, code lists).
